chapter.verse: Tua lai takin Piter leh Johan in thungetna hun nai thum lai takin biakna innpi-ah a kahtoh lai takun,
a nu gil sung pan a khebai mi khat midangte in pua uh a, biakna innpi-a lut mite kiangah khutdawh ngen dingin Hoih Kongkhak kici gei-ah ni simin a koih uh hi.
Piter leh Johan-te in biakna innpi sungah a lut ding uh tua pa in a muh ciangin a khut dawhin hehpihna a ngen hi.
Piter leh Johan in tua pa lim takin en uh a, “Hong en in,” a cih uh ciangin,
amah in na khat peuhmah a ngah ding lamenin sawltakte a ento hi.
Piter in, “Kham leh ngun ka nei kei hi. Ahih hangin ka neihsa kong pia ding hi.
Nazareth khua mi Zeisu Khazih’ min tawh tho in la, kalsuan in,” ci-in a ziatlam khut lenin a phot lai takin a khepeek leh a siakmit guh hat a,
thakhatin tho a, a din’ khit ciangin lam pai-in diang a, Pasian’ min phatin sawltakte tawh biakna innpi sungah a lutkhawm hi.
Tua bangin kalsuan a, Pasian’ min phatin a om, mihonpite in a muh uh ciangin,
biakna innpi Hoih Kongkhak gei-ah khutdawh ngen-a om mipa ahih lam thei uh a, ama tungah a piang thu hangin lamdangsakna leh lungman’na tawh a kidim uh hi.
Tua pa in Piter leh Johan beela a om lai takin Solomon’ Talap kici sungah mi khempeuh in lungmangin a tai uh a, amau kiangah a va kikhawm uh hi.

Piter in tua mite a muh ciangin, “Israel mite aw, hih thu bang hangin lamdangsa na hi uh hiam? Kote vangliatna leh phatna tawh kote in hih pa lam a paisak bangin bang hangin kote hong en gega na hi uh hiam?

Abraham, Isaak leh Jakob’ Pasian, i pu i pate’ Pasian in ama Sila Zeisu a min thangsak zo hi. Note in tua Topa pen gam vaihawmte tungah pia-in, Pilat in khah ding a sawm hangin ama maitang ah tua pa na nial uh hi.
Note in Mi Pha Mi Siangtho na nial uh a, mi thatpa khah nadingin na ngen uh a,
nuntakna hong pia Mangpa na that tazen uh hi! Ahih hangin Pasian in amah a thawhkiksak thu kote in teci ka hi uh hi.
Tua min upna hangin tua Topa’ min in na muh na theih uh hih mi a hatsak hi. Ahi hi, tua Zeisu hanga kingah upna in nomau khempeuh mai-ah hih mi a kicingsak zo hi.
“Tu-in ute naute aw, note akipan no hong ukte in thei loin ahih uh ka thei hi.
Amah Khazih in gimna a thuak ding hi ci-in Pasian in kamsang khempeuhte’ kam tawh a genkholh bangin a tungsak khin zo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Pasian kiang pan nopna hun hong tung a, note ading hong koihsa Khazih Zeisu hong paisak nadingin, note mawhna a sawpsiang nading na kisik un la, na lungsim uh na kikheel un.
Tanglai panin ama kamsang siangthote’ kam uh tawh a genkholh mah bangin na khempeuh a bawl thak kik hun matengin, vantung in Zeisu a sang ding hi.
Moses in, ‘Topa Pasian in nomau ute naute lakah keimah bangin kamsangpa khat note ading a piangsak ding hi. Amah in nomau kiangah thu a gen khempeuh na ngai ding uh hi.
Tua kamsangpa’ thugenna a ngai lo khempeuhte in amau pawl lak pan kimangthangsak ding hi,’ a ci hi.
Samuel pan akipan Pasian’ kamsangte khempeuh leh a nung cianga hong piangte in a gen khempeuhte in, hih nite thu a genkhol zo uh hi.

Note in kamsangte’ suante na hi uh hi. Pasian in Abraham kiangah, ‘Nang na suante hangin leitung mipawl khempeuh in thupha a ngah ding uh hi,’ ci-in na pute na pate uh tawh kiciamna a bawlpihte’ suante zong na hi uh hi.
Pasian in a Silapa hong thawhsak khit ciangin, note na vekpi un na khialhna uh pan hong kikheelsakin, note thupha hong pia dingin note kiangah hong paisak masa hi,” a ci hi.
